find_package(GTest QUIET)
if(GTest_FOUND)
	if(TARGET GTest::gtest_main)
		add_library(gtest_main ALIAS GTest::gtest_main)
		get_target_property(GTEST_MAIN_INCLUDE_DIRS GTest::gtest_main INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
		if(GTEST_MAIN_INCLUDE_DIRS)
			include_directories(${GTEST_MAIN_INCLUDE_DIRS})
		endif()
	elseif(TARGET GTest::gtest)
		add_library(gtest_main UNKNOWN IMPORTED)
	endif()
else()
	# Fallback: try to add_subdirectory if googletest sources are present
	if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps/googletest/CMakeLists.txt")
		add_subdirectory(googletest)
	else()
		message(FATAL_ERROR "GoogleTest not found and deps/googletest not present. Install libgtest-dev or add googletest sources.")
	endif()
endif()
